correctness.rationale: For the post-draw independent-loss chain, exchangeable stationary q_k=P(A present) obeys q_k=s^k((1-k/n)q_k+(k/n)q_{k-1}). This yields exact full mass a_n=prod_{k=1}^n[1+(n/k)(s^{-k}-1)]^{-1}, s=1-c/n. With -n log s→c, continuous f_b(x)=log(1+(e^{bx}-1)/x) yields -log a_n/n→I(c) by uniform Riemann sums including x=0. The empty-start chain is monotonically dominated under common draws and per-label losses by stationarity, so P(T<=t)<=t a_n. Coupling arbitrary starts with identical randomness leaves an initial disagreement only if that label was unselected AND survived all losses, leading to TV<=n[(1-1/n)(1-c/n)]^t. An O(n^2) block reduces TV to <=a_n/2, giving conditional target probability >=a_n/2 at each endpoint, geometric upper tail and E T=exp(nI(c)+o(n)). Strict e^{cx}-1>cx yields I(c)>log(1+c). Independently solved n=3,p=1/3 stationary 8-state system, full mass 128/3105, matching product. This is a logarithmic rate, not a sharp prefactor or exponential limit law.
